entries.symptom: A replay or bot run recorded in Jest diverges on the device (or between iOS and Android)
entries.cause: Hermes computes Math.sin, cos, exp, atan2 and pow with the platform C library; V8 uses its own
entries.fix: Rules, simulations, geometry and daily generation use only + - * /, Math.sqrt, Math.imul, floor, round, abs, min, max and an integer PRNG (sfc32); lint bans the rest there

entries.symptom: A level starts already won or lost
entries.cause: The game's create() returned a finished state
entries.fix: Fix create(); the engine contract test requires every level to start in play

entries.symptom: Two games' daily levels follow the same seed sequence
entries.cause: A game copied the template daily salt
entries.fix: Derive the salt from the game id (FNV-1a of the id); the level checker reports a shared salt

entries.symptom: A fast ball passes through a wall, or a corner hit bounces wrong
entries.cause: Discrete steps skip thin obstacles at high speed
entries.fix: Use swept collision tests, a small fixed step, and properties such as "never leaves the arena" and "energy never increases"

entries.symptom: A real-time simulation drops frames or triggers garbage collection
entries.cause: Vector helpers return new objects on every call; a UI-thread tick must allocate nothing
entries.fix: Write the maths with plain numbers inside the step functions

entries.symptom: Collisions are missed or land in the wrong cell, with no error
entries.cause: The spatial hash expects two numbers per entity, but the body array holds four (x, y, vx, vy)
entries.fix: Pass positions with stride 2, never the raw body array

entries.symptom: The balance check fails [report-stale] although the rules did not change
entries.cause: The report fingerprint covers the game's logic, the simulation file and the shared files they import; one of them changed, or the local report predates the change
entries.fix: Rerun npm run test:sim and the balance check; never edit the report by hand

entries.symptom: After an interruption (a full-screen ad, a background trip) the canvas stays on one frame until the next input
entries.cause: A race between the resume and the next scene push: the UI frame for the old scene reported done and stopped the new scene before its first frame
entries.fix: Tag frame-done messages with their run and ignore stale ones; hold pushes while not runnable; record a frame on every resume. Prove it with a device flow that asserts the scene settles

entries.symptom: A lost run with no continue available never shows its result
entries.cause: The run waited for the user to take or decline a continue offer that was hidden
entries.fix: End the run at once when the offer is unavailable ("never strand a finished run"), with a test for each unavailable reason (offline, no ad, no entitlement)
